title: Mevers School of Excellence
subtitle: Washington, D.C. May 19-21, 2026
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Mevers School of Excellence. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel to Washington, D.C. & Smithsonian Museum of Natural History

  • Travel to Washington, D.C.!
  • Visit the Smithsonian Museum of Natural History
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Check-in to Hotel Accommodations 
  

Day 2: United States Capitol Building Tour & Memorial Visits

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Landmark Leader Led Walking Tour of Arlington National Cemetery
  • Walk up Capitol Hill to the visitors center
  • Lunch Voucher
  • Visit the United States Capitol Building
  • Visit the Library of Congress
  • Visit the Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum
  • Dinner Allocation 
  • Visit the Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam and Korean War Memorials, World War II Memorial and Washington Monument 
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 3: The People’s House & White House Photo Opportunity Stop

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit The People’s House
  • White House Photo Opportunity Stop from Lafayette Park/Pennsylvania Avenue
  • Visit the National Museum of African American History and Culture
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit the Smithsonian Museum of American History
  • Depart for Home
  • Dinner Allocation on the way home
introHeading: Mevers School of Excellence, get ready for an unforgettable Washington, D.C. adventure in 2026! 🏛️
introText: From walking the hallowed grounds of Arlington National Cemetery to exploring the world-class exhibits of the Smithsonian museums, this Washington, D.C. trip brings history, civics, and culture to life at every turn. Students will visit iconic landmarks like the U.S. Capitol and Library of Congress, stand in awe at the Lincoln, WWII, and Vietnam Memorials, and enjoy a White House photo stop from Lafayette Park. It’s the perfect blend of learning, reflection, and discovery—an inspiring experience your students will never forget.
